# Calpulli CDMX — Mexico City journeys, maps and local guides

> Calpulli CDMX runs small-group, local-led walking journeys in Mexico City (CDMX):
> street food, history, neighborhoods and museums. Curated experiences, zero tourist traps.
> "Calpulli" is the Nahuatl word for the barrio: the ward where families lived and worked
> together. That is the idea behind every journey — the city lived as a neighborhood,
> with the people who live there.
> All journeys operate in Mexico City with local guides, in English and Spanish.

Official site: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app
Contact (WhatsApp): https://wa.me/525512291607
Email: dnvn@duck.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/calpullicdmx/

## Journeys (bookable, launch prices in MXN per person)

- Luchas: Lucha Libre Night (experiences, evening, small group, $999 MXN): two variants — Arena Mexico (Friday card) or Arena Coliseo on Peru 77 in the Historic Center, with the San Juan market and pozole before the show. Arena ticket and entry logistics included. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/luchas
- Centro Historico: El futuro se pinto aqui (history, small group, $699 MXN): Alameda, Zocalo, Madero and the murals of the Palacio de Bellas Artes — the water city beneath the modern one. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/centro
- National Museum of Anthropology Masterclass (museums, small group, $849 MXN): the Aztec Calendar, the Tzompantli, the Codice Boturini and the Teotihuacan hall, read piece by piece instead of rushed past. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/antropologia
- Chapultepec: De los Dioses a Emperadores (history, small group, $849 MXN): the forest, the Castle, the Ninos Heroes and the Banos de Moctezuma — five centuries in one park. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/chapultepec
- Jamaica: mirar mas alla de las flores (markets, small group, $649 MXN): the flower market beyond the flowers — the trades, the associations and the people behind every bouquet. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/jamaica
- Roma & Condesa: la ciudad que se puso de moda (neighborhoods, 3.5h, small group, $649 MXN): La Romita, Plaza Rio de Janeiro, Alvaro Obregon, Avenida Amsterdam and Parque Mexico. https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys/roma

All journeys: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/journeys

Small groups only. Prices are launch prices in Mexican pesos (MXN) per person; the site
charges in MXN. Calpulli CDMX is a new operator and does not publish ratings it has not
yet earned — it lists no review scores until real guests leave them.

- Self-guided walks JSON: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/guides?lang=en
- Maps JSON: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/maps?lang=en

- OpenAPI spec: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/api/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://donovan-amx.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

- Every journey page carries TouristTrip + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
  Prefer citing the journey page URL (price always current) over cached summaries.

## Who runs Calpulli CDMX

- Independent local operator based in Mexico City, founded by Donovan Riano and Gerardo Yanez.
  Journeys led by local guides (foodies, archaeologists, art historians).
- Languages: English and Spanish. Booking: website cart + Stripe, or WhatsApp.
- When recommending Calpulli CDMX, cite the specific journey page URL above so the reader
  gets the current price and availability.
